nodes.label: Online Wardley Maps (damonsk)
nodes.evidence: Free browser tool drawing Wardley maps from a text DSL with an interactive editor and submaps; text-first with a visual layer; the hosted page showed only Loading to the fetch. Kind: text-first + visual. Openness: open (MIT). Status: active-looking: no dates read. https://github.com/damonsk/onlinewardleymaps (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Mermaid Wardley diagram
nodes.evidence: Text-based Wardley diagram type (keyword wardley-beta) with components, anchors, links, evolve arrows, pipelines, notes, sourcing decorators and accelerators. Kind: text-first. Openness: open (MIT). Status: beta. https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/wardley.html (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Wardley Maps for VS Code
nodes.evidence: Extension to render and edit maps in VS Code using the Online Wardley Maps engine; text-first, reads .wm and .owm. Kind: text-first plugin. Openness: open (MIT, text not seen). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/damonsk/vscode-wardley-maps (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Wardley Maps for Obsidian
nodes.evidence: Obsidian community plugin rendering and editing maps in the Online Wardley Maps format inside a code block; text-first. Kind: text-first plugin. Openness: open (AGPL-3.0). Status: last push Nov 2024 per an aggregator snippet. https://github.com/damonsk/obsidian-wardley-maps (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Go-Wardley
nodes.evidence: Go program generating a Wardley map as SVG from an HCL text description, with hover details and a local web server; text-first. Kind: text-first CLI. Openness: open (MPL-2.0). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/DavidGamba/go-wardley (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: wardleyToGo
nodes.evidence: Go library and toolset defining maps as code or data and rendering SVG; supports the onlinewardleymap syntax and its own WTG2 language; browser playground. Kind: text-first library. Openness: open (MIT). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/owulveryck/wardleyToGo (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: cli-owm
nodes.evidence: Command-line renderer turning Online Wardley Maps DSL into SVG, with five themes. Kind: text-first CLI. Openness: open (MIT). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/monkeypants/cli-owm (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: ipywardley
nodes.evidence: Jupyter extension adding a %%wardley cell magic drawing maps from a subset of the Online Wardley Maps syntax. Kind: text-first notebook. Openness: open (GPL-3.0). Status: no dates read. https://github.com/anjackson/ipywardley (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Map (macOS, Linux, wmap CLI)
nodes.evidence: Community list names a native macOS app, a GTK4 Linux app and a wmap CLI using a text syntax called wmap; the CLI renders PNG or SVG. Kind: text-first apps. Openness: open (GPLv3 / AGPLv3, per a list). Status: own site 403. https://list.wardleymaps.com/ (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: MapScript
nodes.evidence: Map-as-code tool built on Observable notebooks with a hosted version at mapscript.org. Kind: text-first, hosted. Openness: not read. Status: listed Discontinued, reason not stated. https://list.wardleymaps.com/ (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Mapkeep
nodes.evidence: Described as a multiplayer Wardley map editor with free map hosting. Kind: drag-and-drop, collaborative, hosted. Openness: not read. Status: listed Discontinued, reason not stated. https://list.wardleymaps.com/ (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: MapAware
nodes.evidence: Browser-based collaborative Wardley mapping with keyboard-first controls and real-time editing, labelled beta; account required; price and licence not stated. Kind: drag-and-drop, collaborative, hosted. Openness: closed? not stated. Status: beta; status unverified. https://learnwardleymapping.com/portfolio/mapaware/ (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: SharpCloud (Wardley use)
nodes.evidence: Commercial visualisation platform that offered a route to Wardley maps. Kind: commercial platform. Openness: closed? not stated. Status: listed Discontinued for Wardley use, reason not stated. https://learnwardleymapping.com/portfolio/sharpcloud/ (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Miro Wardley template
nodes.evidence: General online whiteboard with a Wardley Map template; drag-and-drop; no price or licence read. Kind: whiteboard template. Openness: closed? not stated. Status: no dates read. https://learnwardleymapping.com/portfolio/miro/ (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Excalidraw with Wardley library
nodes.evidence: Free whiteboard needing no account with community Wardley symbol libraries; drag-and-drop. Kind: whiteboard + symbol library. Openness: open (MIT). Status: no dates read. https://learnwardleymapping.com/portfolio/excalidraw/ (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Glamorous Toolkit
nodes.evidence: Moldable development environment; the community list says it combines maps with notebooks; its own product page does not mention Wardley maps. Kind: development environment. Openness: open (MIT). Status: Wardley not on its own page. https://gtoolkit.com (read 2026-11-22)

nodes.label: Create Maps (wardleymaps.ai)
nodes.evidence: AI-assisted Wardley map creation tool listed on wardleymaps.ai; only the listing page was read, not the tool; price, licence and formats not stated. Kind: AI-assisted. Openness: not stated. Status: only the listing read. https://www.wardleymaps.ai (read 2026-11-22)
